hero.title: Better dashboards. Better decisions.
hero.subtitle: Workshop + tool access for BI teams that want clearer dashboards, sharper requirements and lower cognitive load.
body: CogniCheck helps BI teams, controllers and dashboard developers evaluate whether reports actually help people understand complexity and make decisions.

sections.title: What CogniCheck helps teams improve
body: The workshop combines BI consulting, cognitive psychology and practical tool access so teams can improve both requirements and existing reports.

cards.title: Sharper dashboard requirements
cards.body: Move from broad stakeholder requests to clearer decisions, assumptions, KPI definitions and implementation direction.

cards.title: Cognitive report review
cards.body: Evaluate where a dashboard creates unnecessary mental effort, weak hierarchy or hidden interpretation work.

cards.title: Decision-support diagnosis
cards.body: Check whether the report helps the intended user see what matters, compare correctly and know when action is needed.

cards.title: Actionable improvement plan
cards.body: Leave with prioritized changes that connect dashboard design choices to cognition and business decision quality.

sections.title: The workshop journey
body: CogniCheck is designed as a guided engagement, not just a tool login. The website, workshop and demo tools work together.

sections.title: What teams receive
body: The goal is a practical output that can be discussed with BI developers, stakeholders and business owners.

cards.title: Dashboard review
cards.body: A concise CogniCheck analysis focused on cognitive load, decision alignment and highest-leverage improvements.

cards.title: BI blueprint
cards.body: A structured translation of requirements into decisions, metrics, risks, assumptions and implementation direction.

cards.title: Team learning
cards.body: A reusable way of thinking about dashboard quality using attention, working memory, grouping and decision logic.

sections.title: Workshop formats
body: CogniCheck can be used as a compact dashboard review session, a team workshop or a paid pilot with temporary tool access.

cards.title: Intro workshop
cards.body: A focused session on cognitive load, dashboard interpretation and decision-ready BI.
cards.label: View workshop

cards.title: Dashboard review package
cards.body: Review one or more existing dashboards and turn the findings into concrete improvement actions.
cards.label: See deliverables

cards.title: Pilot access
cards.body: Temporary access to CogniCheck tools so a team can test requirements-to-blueprint and report analysis workflows.
cards.label: Request access

sections.title: About CogniCheck
body: CogniCheck was created by Robin Groen, a BI analyst with a background in psychology, management and data analytics.
The project started from a simple belief: good BI is not only about data. It is about helping people understand complexity and make better decisions.
